title: [1.15 Hotfix] Fix naval AI and northern passability; migrate journal outcomes
body:
## Problem and resulting behavior
Victoria 3 1.15 rejects legacy journal conclusion fields. This branch migrates two bounded batches to scripted outcomes: the original six files in #27, followed by the explicitly requested Sick Man of Europe continuation in `00_sick_man.txt`. Together these are **16 journals in 7 gameplay files, with 48 legacy fields replaced by 32 outcomes**. Authored criteria, effects, scopes and cleanup are retained.

The branch also includes the bounded Russian Northern Norway passability correction (#37), the locally accepted naval AI unpause-crash correction (#36) and two approved native copper-icon references (#33/#23). The crash investigation is not reopened. No map overhaul, law-audit change, copper redistribution, country-setup change or main merge is included.

Refs #27/#24 (journals), #36 (accepted locally), #20/#19 (baseline/coordination), #33/#23 (icons). No automatic issue closure.

## Northern Norway passability — #37
Commit [6d2d9f7](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/6d2d9f7684f1c5618b9c17ec6e558b44b6f7deab) removes four inherited impassable IDs from the existing Russian part of `STATE_NORTHERN_NORWAY` (`map_data/state_regions/00_west_europe.txt:177`). Those four owned/populated provinces were all blocked. **One gameplay line changes; 33 other impassables, borders, ownership, population, terrain, hubs and resources are preserved.**

Installed directly in the regular local mod/playset **hhhh**. Static audit passes: 133 provinces with complete unique ownership, Russian passable count 0 → 4, unchanged DENNOR count, unique strategic region, and pixel-edge paths to Kola. 1,089 protected local files retain their hashes. Four committed files read back exactly; remote gameplay comparison is one line. [Evidence and runtime protocol](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE37_NORTHERN_NORWAY_2026_11_07.md).

This is a confirmed configuration defect; introduction by 1.15 is unproven. Engine rendering/movement, neighboring impassables and save/reload still require in-game acceptance. #37 remains open.

## Journal changes
- First batch, commit [1b94162](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/1b9416263775c56e607c86af9fbbe490feef7077): USA French support, revolutionary spirit, Ottoman reforms, imperial centralization, imperial situation/vote and birth-quota trial. **8 journals / 22 legacy fields → 15 outcomes**; 14 original predicates and every effect body retained.
- Sick Man continuation, commit [2f06ad3](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/2f06ad31c9fac166a7316b67f19bcdd576d9a10d): **8 journals / 26 legacy fields → 17 outcomes**, in one gameplay file. Preserve 16 predicates, ten effect bodies/order, four required reforms and the **10,950-day** deadline. Main timeout has no trigger and uses the native timeout flag/presentation; seven invalidations stay silent.
- Non-conclusion behavior remains token-equivalent: activation, immediate/pulses, modifiers, progress bars, thresholds, buttons/widgets, transfer/inheritance flags, variables, event lists and DLC gates.
- The first batch's orphan Ottoman invalidation handler retains a dormant hidden outcome (`always = no`); no new condition is invented. Sick Man retains original ownership/subject checks, strict separatism thresholds and existing cultural/bureaucracy cleanup.

[First-batch mapping and tests](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE27_JOURNAL_BATCH1_2026_11_06.md) · [Sick Man mapping and runtime protocol](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE27_SICK_MAN_2026_11_07.md) · [Sick Man validation](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/blob/hotfix/1.15/docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE27_SICK_MAN_VALIDATION_2026_11_07.json).

## Local delivery
**Both batches are installed in the regular local mod used by active playset `hhhh`.** Read-only launcher verification confirms the path; no extra registered copy or playset switch is needed. The previous remote-only delivery statements in the dated November 6 report describe an earlier stage.

The installation preserved all pre-existing local status entries and accepted naval files, backed up source bytes and avoided checkout/reset/local Git metadata writes. Only the approved copper icon references were installed; resource distribution, capacity, recipes and yields are unchanged.

## Validation
- Installed Sick Man audit: **PASS_STATIC_ONLY**, 8 journals / 17 outcomes / zero errors; all ten negative controls detected.
- Installed first-batch regression audit: **PASS_STATIC_ONLY**, 8 journals / 15 outcomes / zero errors; its original eight negative controls are documented separately.
- All nine standard/timeout localization keys resolve in native English/French. No new player-facing prose.
- Four new/extended files read back exactly at the Sick Man commit. The scoped commit changes one gameplay file, the reusable read-only audit and two evidence files.
- Remaining inventory: **1,425 direct legacy fields in 170 other journal files**; not a bug count. Eastern Crisis continuation and other initialization/scope debt remain outside these bounded batches.
- Naval correction: 25 category lines in three files, accepted locally by the maintainer.
- Copper icons still require visual acceptance. No new game run or Paradox parser test is claimed for this journal delivery.

## Acceptance before integration
- [ ] Human review of both bounded mappings, the dormant Ottoman cleanup choice and the four-province passability patch.
- [ ] Fresh Russia game: inspect the Russian Northern Norway state part, test land movement where permitted, adjacent intended impassables and save/reload (#37).
- [ ] Fresh 1776 USA, Ottoman and imperial sessions; inspect all affected entries and the birth-quota trial where available.
- [ ] Exercise every Sick Man reform, main success/timeout, separatism failure, invalidation and modifier/culture cleanup; confirm one application of counters/events.
- [ ] Test simultaneous predicates, the exact timeout boundary, forced removal and relevant DLC branches; record Eastern Crisis dependency failures separately.
- [ ] Save/reload active and concluded entries, advance again and compare all rotated parser/runtime logs with #20.
- [ ] Validate the final combined branch and copper icons; obtain runtime acceptance and explicit integration authorization.

PR remains **draft**, #27 remains **open**, and neither is Done. Project editing tools are unavailable in this session; the last verified #27 status was In review with this PR linked. #20/#25 remain open. #37 is tracked under map parent #24; its four-province configuration defect is corrected, with visual/gameplay acceptance pending.
